module.en: Placeable specialization that turns a building into a workshop by creating a VehicleSellingPoint from `placeable.workshop.sellingPoint`. The selling point is linked back to the placeable and its owner farm is kept in step.
module.fr: Spécialisation de placeable qui transforme un bâtiment en atelier en créant un VehicleSellingPoint à partir de `placeable.workshop.sellingPoint`. Le point de vente est relié au placeable et sa ferme propriétaire reste synchronisée.

PlaceableWorkshop.prerequisitesPresent.en: Always returns true: no prerequisite specialization.
PlaceableWorkshop.prerequisitesPresent.fr: Renvoie toujours true : aucune spécialisation requise.

PlaceableWorkshop.registerOverwrittenFun.fr: Surcharge `setOwnerFarmId` sur le type de placeable.

PlaceableWorkshop.registerXMLPaths.en: Declares the selling point XML keys via `VehicleSellingPoint.registerXMLPaths` under `.workshop.sellingPoint`.
PlaceableWorkshop.registerXMLPaths.fr: Déclare les clés XML du point de vente via `VehicleSellingPoint.registerXMLPaths` sous `.workshop.sellingPoint`.

PlaceableWorkshop:onLoad.en: Creates and loads the VehicleSellingPoint, sets its owner farm and stores `owningPlaceable` on it.
PlaceableWorkshop:onLoad.fr: Crée et charge le VehicleSellingPoint, fixe sa ferme propriétaire et y stocke `owningPlaceable`.

PlaceableWorkshop:onDelete.en: Deletes the selling point if it exists.
PlaceableWorkshop:onDelete.fr: Supprime le point de vente s'il existe.

PlaceableWorkshop:setOwnerFarmId.en: Calls the parent, then propagates the new owner farm to the selling point.
PlaceableWorkshop:setOwnerFarmId.fr: Appelle le parent, puis propage la nouvelle ferme propriétaire au point de vente.
